title: Sections step output (v1)
description: Output of one sub-call of pipeline step 3 (spec 3.6): the activities of a single section or subsection, whose id the orchestrator matches against the outline. Activities are referenced from blueprint.v1.json, so the per-type content rules apply unchanged.

id.description: Id of the section or subsection these activities belong to.

content_activity.description: An activity of step 3: only the content types of this step (spec 3.6 row 3). Lesson, quiz and the other interactive types are added by the activities and questions steps.
